name: backspace, sequential: fix a wrong char after a pause
why: One target, s1 'go on' (the inner space is part of the text; it is the last target, so no trailing space).
Keys: g o space i(wrong for o at index 3) n(right at index 4, but the target cannot complete while index 3 is wrong) x(the target is full: wrong with no expected char).
Pause at 2000, resume at 12000 (10000 ms paused). Then Backspace, Backspace, o, n: the target completes at 13600. End at 40000.
keystrokes = g o space i n x o n = 8 (Backspace is not a keystroke). correct = g o space n o n = 6. errors = 2. accuracy = 6 / 8 = 0.75.
grossWpm = (6 / 5) / 0.5 = 2.4. uncorrected is always 0 under backspace, so netWpm = 2.4.
Latencies: o 400, space 400, n 400; after the resume the first key is a Backspace, so o at 13200 is 400 after the Backspace at 12800, and n is 400. Five samples, so consistency = 0.
Streak: g o space = 3, broken by i; n = 1, broken by x; o n = 2. longestStreak = 3.
perKey: o = right (index 1) + wrong i (index 3) + right (index 3 again) = 3 attempts, 1 error. n is typed right twice. The x past the end belongs to no key.
bigrams: ' o' = wrong + right = 2 attempts, 1 error. 'on' = 2 attempts.
